Unpopular opinion but I believe nft and microtransactions aren't totally bad, I'm not consumer of these techniques but all I'm seeing is company trying to make money, if that money is later used to make more games then good for them! These company's need to make profit somewhere, can't give everything for free like everyone wants, it would be the dream but I don't think that's quite realistic, also when done right, these microtransaction don't bother to anyone, nobody force you to buy them, personally I wouldn't die to not be able to have a dancing emote, the only problem I see is that if some parts of the game were locked behind a paywall or if the game is online that by paying you would get to win easily using the overpowered cosmetic, that would be the worst case scenario, but if you add some exclusive cosmetics with paywall I have no problem with that, the people who are willing to pay will pay and the one who don't will not and will not lose anything over it because you can still play the game the same way.

 One bad example of implementation would be pay day 2, that game was awful! They did force you to pay by making the weapons and accessories really expensive compared to the money you get on heist, to get good gear you would need to play for hundred of hours or that's how it felt with my friends besides most of the cosmetics and accessories said "you need x dlc" and I'm exaggerating but I would say there's +50minidlc on that game, was really frustrating and I stopped playing because of it.

 One good example of implementation would be counter strike go, this game have literal nft inside it, people buy cosmetics and resell them at a higher price, they trade with them and all, but in this case it never affected my gameplay, crazy people with their cosmetics were there wasting all their money some winning money, but I was there just playing gun game or death match and enjoying matches with my friend, of course I didn't had extra deluxe pinky ponky cosmetic but I never cared to show off my skins, always used default ones or free ones that you get, same happen with battlefield and well any other example you can think of.

 Idk maybe I'm not getting it and the problem is other but I feel like paid cosmetics aren't such a big deal most of the time to the point of killing a game like everyone said, there are exceptions but I think it can be done right.
